data.title: 小鞠知花 · 温泉暖雾中的羞涩娇小依偎
data.description: 私密家庭温泉浴池内水汽袅袅，薄荷色连体泳衣已被解开。知花浑身肌肤被热水蒸得泛粉，娇小的身躯几乎整个人缩在你的怀中，在心跳如雷中羞怯地承受着温柔的抚弄。
data.location: steamy private indoor cedar hot spring bath
data.action: 知花浑身肌肤被热水蒸得泛粉，娇小的身躯几乎整个人缩在你的怀中
data.lighting: warm amber water lamps shining through thick steamy mist
data.promptProse: Inside a mist-filled private cedar hot spring glowing under warm lanterns, Chika curls closely into her partner's embrace with her wet hair clinging to her shoulders and her cheeks steamed bright pink.
data.animaCaption: Tucked shyly against her partner's chest inside the steaming private family hot spring under warm lantern light, she hides her deeply flushed face against him with damp hair and her ruffled pastel-mint swimsuit slipped loose off her shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her ruffled pastel-mint one-piece swimsuit has been loosened off her bare shoulders in the warm water while steam swirls around their embrace.
